Steps: Go to /auth, sign in with an admin account.
Expected result: Redirected to /admin dashboard; sidebar shows Dashboard, Events, Scoring Rubrics, Submissions, Judge Broadcast, Settings.

Steps: Sign in with a judge account.
Expected result: Redirected to /judge; judge sidebar and message bell visible; no admin routes reachable.

Steps: Sign in with a gym_coach account.
Expected result: Redirected to /m (mobile coach app); only assigned events visible.

Steps: Attempt sign-in with a wrong password.
Expected result: Clear error toast; no session created; no redirect.

Steps: Use Forgot Password, open email link, set a new password.
Expected result: Reset email received; new password works; old password rejected.

Steps: Admin > Settings > User Roles > Edit user > set new password. Sign in as that user on web and mobile.
Expected result: New password works on both web portal and mobile coach app.

Steps: While signed out, open /admin, /judge and /m directly.
Expected result: Redirected to sign-in; no protected data rendered.

Steps: Click Log Out from the sidebar.
Expected result: Session cleared; returned to sign-in; back button does not restore the portal.

Steps: Settings > Organizations > add a new organization with name and contact details.
Expected result: Organization saved and appears in the list.

Steps: Settings > User Roles > Create User, leave Organization blank.
Expected result: Validation blocks submit until an organization is selected.

Steps: In Create/Edit user, type part of an organization name in the org box.
Expected result: Combobox filters as you type; selection persists after save.

Steps: On User Roles, use the search field and role filter chips (Admin / Judge / Coach).
Expected result: Table filters correctly; counts match the visible rows.

Steps: Edit a user, upload an avatar, save, then reload.
Expected result: Avatar shows in the user table and in the sidebar for that user.

Steps: Delete a test user.
Expected result: User removed from list and can no longer sign in.

Steps: Events > New Event: name, dates, scoring open date, template.
Expected result: Event appears in the events table with status Registration Open.

Steps: Click the status badge in the events table and pick another status.
Expected result: Status updates instantly and persists after refresh.

Steps: Move an event through Registration Open > Open for Capture > Open for Scoring > Completed > Archived.
Expected result: Capture allowed only from Open for Capture onward; judges can score in Open for Capture and Open for Scoring; Completed/Archived hide judge messages and lock scoring.

Steps: Change event name/dates and save.
Expected result: Changes reflected on dashboard tiles, judge dashboard, and mobile coach list.

Steps: Open Admin Dashboard.
Expected result: Current Events and Upcoming Events tiles list the right events; Currently Online shows active users; card icons are brand teal.

Steps: Event > Registrations > Add Team with division, level and coach.
Expected result: Team saved; Gym column auto-fills from the coach's organization.

Steps: Change a team's division and save.
Expected result: Division updates in Registrations, Submissions, Scoring and Results views.

Steps: Import a CSV where all organizations and coaches already exist.
Expected result: All rows imported; summary counts match the file; no duplicates created.

Steps: Import a CSV containing a new gym_name and a new coach email.
Expected result: Organization auto-created; coach account auto-created and linked to that organization; team registered.

Steps: Import a CSV with a missing division and a malformed email.
Expected result: Row-level errors reported clearly; valid rows still import; invalid rows skipped.

Steps: Register two teams with the same name in one event.
Expected result: System warns about duplicate names as designed.

Steps: Settings > Scoring Templates > create a template with a discipline.
Expected result: Template is created and grouped under the correct discipline tab; list shows one template per line.

Steps: Add sections and numeric fields with max points.
Expected result: Total available points updates correctly.

Steps: Add a Difficulty Driver field with skills and radio option values.
Expected result: Judge sees radio options per skill; selected values sum into the field score.

Steps: Add an Execution Driver field with a start value and technique-issue reductions.
Expected result: Score = start value minus selected reductions, never below zero.

Steps: As a judge, select technique issues on an Execution Driver field.
Expected result: Comments box gains a bold + underlined field header and a bold line per issue: 'Issue: -value'.

Steps: Set an event to Open for Scoring, then try to edit its template.
Expected result: Template is locked; edits blocked with a clear message.

Steps: Settings > Divisions & Levels: add, edit and filter by discipline.
Expected result: All Star Cheer and All-Star Dance divisions/levels list correctly.

Steps: Upload a rubric with a discipline; open Scoring Rubrics menu in admin and judge sidebars.
Expected result: Rubric listed with its discipline; All-Star Cheer link opens unitedscoringpartners.com in a new tab.

Steps: Event > configure judge panels (e.g. B1, B2, SD).
Expected result: Panels saved with their scoring responsibilities.

Steps: Open Assign Panels; expand a division collapsible and assign judges to every section.
Expected result: Green check icon appears on the division once fully assigned.

Steps: Use bulk judge assignment across multiple divisions.
Expected result: Assignments applied; conflicts (same judge, same slot) are flagged.

Steps: Assign a judge to the SD panel and open scoring as that judge.
Expected result: SD judge sees only the deductions catalog, not other scoring sections.

Steps: Open /m on a phone and sign in as a coach.
Expected result: Assigned events list loads.

Steps: Tap an event.
Expected result: Teams list with instruction text 'Tap the Team name below to record and submit their performance for Scoring.'

Steps: Tap a team, then Record. Check portrait and landscape.
Expected result: Start button floats centered over the viewport; buttons stack cleanly with no truncated text; audio meter works.

Steps: Record a short clip and submit.
Expected result: Upload progress shown; submission status becomes Uploaded; video lands in a Brightcove folder named after the event.

Steps: Open the submission immediately after upload in admin.
Expected result: 'Video is still rendering' placeholder with Check again / Try playback anyway, not a Brightcove error.

Steps: Wait for Brightcove processing, reopen the submission and the coach's team detail screen.
Expected result: Video plays in both places.

Steps: Set a video submission deadline in the past and try to upload.
Expected result: Deadline enforced/communicated as configured.

Steps: Sign in as a judge.
Expected result: Assigned events grouped by event with 'Scoring opens <date>' or 'Scoring date TBD'.

Steps: Check the scoring queue.
Expected result: Only teams the judge is assigned to, in open events with a valid submission, are listed.

Steps: Open a performance and enter scores using the +/- steppers.
Expected result: Values change in the configured increments; running total shows points out of available points with no percentage.

Steps: Use bold, italic, underline and spell check in the comments field.
Expected result: Formatting markers applied and rendered on the scoresheet.

Steps: Enter partial scores and Save Draft; leave and return.
Expected result: Queue shows 'Draft Saved' with Resume Draft; values restored; admin sees draft status and can preview.

Steps: Submit a completed scoresheet.
Expected result: Panel marked submitted; judge can no longer edit; admin sees submitted status.

Steps: Admin re-opens the panel from the score review screen.
Expected result: Panel returns to the judge's queue as a draft with prior scores intact; judge can edit and resubmit.

Steps: Event > Scoring > open a submission.
Expected result: Assigned judge shown as a badge; per-panel scores listed; video player embedded.

Steps: Override a field score to 0 with a reason.
Expected result: Override recorded with reason; totals recalculated; override visible on review and scoresheet.

Steps: Compare a submission's totals by hand.
Expected result: total = (sum of field points / template max points) x 100, minus the SD judge's total deductions (% Perfection). Event score equals % Perfection.

Steps: Enter a 0.15 deduction as the SD judge.
Expected result: 0.15 is subtracted from the 100-point scale total, not averaged across judges.

Steps: Publish results for an event.
Expected result: Results become visible only after manual publish.

Steps: Download a scoresheet PDF for a fully scored team and a partially scored team.
Expected result: All template criteria rows always shown; unscored rows blank/greyed with max points; difficulty + execution for the same criterion share one row with a combined total.

Steps: Event > Reports: generate Overall, By Level, and per-Division rankings.
Expected result: Rankings ordered by % Perfection to 4 decimals; ties handled; PDFs open cleanly.

Steps: Trigger scoresheet distribution once all panels submit.
Expected result: Email sent with correct branding/logo and the right scoresheet attached.

Steps: Admin > Judge Broadcast: send a normal and an urgent message to an event's judges.
Expected result: Teal banner for normal, red for urgent, appearing live for signed-in judges and on next login.

Steps: Open the bell icon as a judge.
Expected result: Unread badge count correct; messages listed; messages from Completed/Archived events hidden.

Steps: Generate a review link and open it signed out.
Expected result: Token URL loads the team's performances and scores read-only.

Steps: Use bulk email from Submissions to request videos or share review links.
Expected result: Emails queued/sent to the right recipients with working links.

Steps: Settings > Email templates: edit a template with variables and send a test.
Expected result: Variables resolve; branding logo renders from the public asset bucket.

Steps: Settings > Branding: upload a logo and change the primary colour.
Expected result: Logo appears in sidebars and emails; theme colour updates across the portal after refresh.

Steps: Switch the active video provider and save credentials.
Expected result: Setting persists; uploads route to the selected provider.

Steps: Settings > Mobile API Access > View API Access.
Expected result: Base URL and anon key shown; reveal/copy buttons work; example curl matches the live URL.

Steps: Settings > Testing & QA: download the PDF, Markdown and CSV checklist.
Expected result: All three files download and open correctly.

Steps: Toggle notification settings and save.
Expected result: Values persist after reload and drive the matching emails.

Steps: POST with apikey header and coach credentials.
Expected result: 200 with a 64-character session token.

Steps: GET with Authorization: Bearer <token>.
Expected result: 200 with the coach profile and organization.

Steps: GET with a valid token.
Expected result: Only events assigned to that coach returned.

Steps: GET for an event.
Expected result: Teams owned by the coach (matched by coach_user_id or coach_email) returned.

Steps: Run an upload handshake for an email-matched coach.
Expected result: Both calls succeed; no ownership rejection.

Steps: Call any endpoint with a missing or expired token.
Expected result: 401 with a clear error body; no data leaked.

Steps: POST with a valid token, then reuse the token.
Expected result: Token invalidated; subsequent calls return 401.

Steps: Check admin, judge and coach views at 375px, 768px and 1440px.
Expected result: No overflow, unreadable text or clipped buttons.

Steps: Collapse and expand the admin and judge sidebars.
Expected result: Icon-only mode with tooltips; nested Events/Settings menus behave correctly.

Steps: As a judge or coach, attempt to load an admin URL directly.
Expected result: Access denied / redirect; no admin data returned.

Steps: Change a team's division after scores exist.
Expected result: Scores and template association behave as expected; verify scoresheet still renders.

Steps: Keep the browser console open through a full pass.
Expected result: No uncaught errors or failed network requests.

Steps: Throttle the network during a mobile upload.
Expected result: Graceful error and retry; no duplicate submissions.
